# User preferences (keywords: preference, semantic HTML, markup, style)

- Standing instruction (given 2024-03-15): whenever the user asks about markup structure, always include semantic HTML5 tag usage details (which tag to use, why, and what to avoid).
- Standing instruction (given 2024-04-10): whenever the user asks about debugging an issue, always provide detailed error messages: the full error text, error type, stack trace or console line, file and line, HTTP status and URL where relevant, and the exact reproduction steps.
- Standing instruction (given 2024-05-05, user stated directly): when the user asks about site speed improvements, always report exact performance metrics. Report only measured values, with the tool, version, device/network conditions, and run count. Never estimate or invent numbers; if no measurement exists, say so and give the command to produce one. User-reported figures so far (unverified): TTI 3.5s -> 2.1s, repeat load 1.2s -> 400ms, render-blocking CSS delay 300ms.

# Project context (keywords: portfolio, Craig, Bootstrap, sprint)

- Single-page portfolio for Craig, a Colour Technologist from Port Michael.
- Sections: About, Skills, Projects (6-item gallery), Contact (validated form). Bootstrap 5.3.0, mobile-first breakpoints 576/768/992px, 1200x800 desktop target.
- Sprint 1 deadline moved from April 1 to April 5, 2024 (basic layout and navigation, plus build-time accessibility items). Peer review on April 2, 2024 (semantic HTML and WCAG 2.1 AA).
- Browsers for manual testing: Chrome 112, Firefox 110.
- Launch date: public launch May 10, 2024. Bundle budget under 100KB (user preference).
- Session 2024-05-05: advised lazysizes 5.3.2 (self-host, ~4KB min+gzip) with data-src/lazyload markup, and Bootstrap 5.3 modal ARIA (role="dialog", aria-modal, aria-labelledby/describedby, button triggers with aria-label). Native loading="lazy" noted as zero-JS option (supported in both test browsers).
- Session 2024-05-05 (page weight): site 1.8MB -> 1.2MB after image compression + PostCSS 8.4.21 minify. Deploys to GitHub Pages via GitHub Actions. User cited "pipeline v2.4.1" and "99.9% uptime": neither verifiable (no such Actions version; Pages has no published uptime SLA). Advised: PurgeCSS on Bootstrap (safelist JS-added classes), self-host subset fonts, esbuild-tree-shake Bootstrap JS, CI size budget script, Pages caches ~10 min and gzips text only.
